accessToken.description: Current opaque WhaleU access token; publication requires an approved home-school organization and an actual target owner/admin grant.

get.description: Separately labelled native publication source. Does not replace, merge totals with, or rewrite accepted legacy catalogs.

post.description: Account/draft isolated original-key commands. Publication freezes exact text/types/current organization/QR/media and enters independent review. Pending review must resume the original key and payload. No external production reviewer is enabled.

get.description: History belongs to the immutable original publisher, not the organization current owner.
Current approved home-school organizations with real target owner/admin grants; legacy directory entries and school reviewer roles do not authorize publishing.

400.description: Strict validation rejects unknown query/body keys and invalid identifiers or variants.

401.description: Current valid opaque bearer session required; no anonymous access.

403.description: Current owner or parent authority denies access.

404.description: Missing or inaccessible intent/binding; no hidden parent or storage disclosure.

409.description: MEDIA_NOT_READY or command conflict; refresh intent status.

429.description: MEDIA_RATE_LIMITED: bounded new request-key or actual-transfer budget exhausted; preserve the original journal and retry later.

503.description: MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE: default runtime is disabled. Missing storage, transform, safety or owner authority fails closed. Range requests are unsupported and return MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE; no partial content or redirect.
